fields.value: Study 2: characteristics of cases on resident dismissal at the Dutch conciliation board - Study 2E: Unprofessional behaviours in residents from hospital-based specialties
Judith Dekker: PhD Project data for study 2

dsDescriptionValue.value:
Summary

This study examined 61 conciliation board cases of residents of who 39 were dismissed for failing to meet the competencies of the CanMEDS professional domain, whose unprofessional behaviors where categorized with the 4I’s-model (on inadequate introspection, interaction, integrity, involvement).

Research Questions

Which resident behaviour had been perceived as unprofessional by program directors in hospital-based specialties as reported in cases of residents who disputed dismissal?

Framework

4I’s model on unprofessional behaviours

Methods

Quantitative and qualitative analysis of descriptions of unprofessional behaviours

Source

61 Conciliation board (RGS-GC) cases from hospital-based specialties
